topic: A wedding in the family in 3 years: a goal-based monthly plan
judge_note: A concrete 36-month countdown to a cousin's wedding is clear and local, and the tone is calm rather than fearful.

slides.headline: Cousin's wedding is 36 months away. Plan it calmly.
slides.subhead: Every family function is a goal, and every goal needs a start date.

slides.title: Plan for a wedding three years away

points.title: Pick your target amount
points.text: Decide what you want to gift or contribute. Set that number first.

points.title: Divide by 36 months
points.text: ₹3 lakh over 36 months is about ₹8,300 monthly, before market ups and downs.

points.title: Start now, breathe later
points.text: Each month you wait, the monthly amount needed rises. Starting today means smaller bites.

slides.headline: Save this for the next family gathering.
slides.cta: Share with the sibling or cousin who's planning ahead.
slides.footnote: Three years is short, so match funds to your risk. Market risks apply.

caption:
The best wedding gift is a calm monthly plan.

Dividing a goal by 36 months makes it feel lighter. Market risks apply.

Whose wedding are you planning ahead for?
